meta.name: build
meta.description: Implement a scoped software change for a customer and verify its behavior. Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按明确需求改好一段代码,并验证它真的按预期运行。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一个范围明确的改动,要做完并确认它没坏。
copy.tagline_en: Ship a scoped code change and confirm it runs as expected.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have one well-defined code change to build and verify.

howto.what: Claude 会先读任务上下文约定与实现方法,再按客户代码库的指示完成一个有明确范围的软件改动,并验证改动行为;缺少的能力或未执行的检查会如实上报。
howto.when: 当你交代一项结果明确的客户交付改动时接管,不用于事故响应。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其现有的净化上下文与范围,不重启设置或重复已答的问题。

say.text: 按客户仓库的约定实现这个改动并验证它的行为
say.note: 会先读任务上下文约定与实现方法

say.text: 只用我给的这份上下文做,不用新建 engagement 目录
say.note: 未绑定 engagement 时记录文件名是可选的

say.text: 这项检查没跑成,直接说明,别写成已完成
say.note: 缺能力或未跑的检查会如实报告

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and the build method, implements a scoped software change in the customer's repo, and verifies its behavior; missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported honestly.
howto.when_en: Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response. If called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Implement this change following the customer repo's instructions and verify it.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: Work only from this context; don't create an engagement folder.
say_en.note: Those records are optional when no engagement is bound.

say_en.text: If a check didn't run, say so instead of marking it done.
say_en.note: Missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported.
